app.name: Vivah Khata
app.tagline: Every rupee, every gift, every guest — one family record.

welcome.title: Vivah Khata
welcome.subtitle: The shared digital ledger for Indian weddings.
welcome.benefit1_desc: Father, uncles, brothers and the couple all record what they paid in cash, UPI or card.
welcome.benefit2_desc: Log cash envelopes (chadivimpulu) and gold during the wedding; keep the record for life.
welcome.benefit3_desc: No network at the wedding hall? Everything saves instantly and syncs when online.
welcome.privacy_note: By continuing, you agree to our family privacy terms. We never share or sell your wedding data.
